sees: frame 1: Faint office background (windows, desk) on a green gradient. Two items on a white panel: a grey-topped document card labelled BURDEN, and a phone/battery-like icon labelled BURNOUT with only a small dark fill at the bottom (nearly empty).

frame 2: The BURDEN card's header turns green and a green circle highlights it. A curved arrow now runs from BURDEN to BURNOUT, and the BURNOUT icon is filled mostly dark with a dashed line near the bottom.
frame 3: Same as frame 2: BURDEN highlighted green with the arrow to BURNOUT, BURNOUT icon mostly filled dark, dashed line below the fill top.
changed: The BURDEN card became highlighted (green) and an arrow connecting it to BURNOUT appeared; the BURNOUT icon's fill rose from a small amount to nearly full.
cause: The burden is shown leading to / feeding into burnout (the arrow from BURDEN to BURNOUT).
effect: Burnout level rises (the gauge fills up) as a result of burden.
message: The narrator is saying that accumulating burden drives you toward burnout, filling up your capacity until you are depleted.
wouldConfuse: The BURNOUT icon looks like a phone or battery, so a full dark fill could be read as a charged battery (good) rather than rising burnout; the green highlight on BURDEN also reads as positive. The dashed line meaning is unclear.
